property: At most one contender with the same pre-reservation ledger hash is accepted.

mapping.Acquire: atomic mkdir identity-ledger.json.lock; failure refuses reservation
mapping.Check: sha256_file ledger equals bound_ledger_sha256 after acquisition
mapping.Publish: jq staged append followed by mv temp_ledger ledger

assumptions: mkdir and same-directory rename are atomic
every writer honors this same lock
two contenders each uses the same initial hash and attempts once
mapping_recheck: Research input authorization changed outside the reservation transaction; the reservation tail is byte-identical to the prior verified source.
